title: Driver-specific automatic settings and equipment-dependent features
summary: This topic mainly contains incomplete or descriptive references to equipment-dependent functions, with one clear positive example about the vehicle automatically storing and adjusting driver settings.

positive.summary: The positive feedback praises automatic storage and adjustment of personalized settings based on who is driving.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined excerpts mention equipment-dependent options and automatic speed adjustment around corners, but they are too fragmentary to confirm a clear evaluation.

limitations: Most sampled excerpts are incomplete phrases, so the underlying customer opinion is unclear in several cases.
The cluster mixes personalized settings, equipment/version qualifiers, and speed adjustment behavior, so the topic is somewhat heterogeneous.
Examples are few, so they are insufficient to support broader conclusions beyond the cited fragments.
